messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — AcmeBank on the POC call asked for a streaming integration that uses function-calls for enrichment and emits structured JSON lines to their proxy. They also require on-prem KMS + SOC2 proofs before pilot. Can we confirm any non-starter blockers?

alex: Thanks — couple things: 1) streaming + function-calls is supported by our SDKs (node/go/python) via SSE/websocket paths. 2) on-prem KMS is doable with Private but needs the KMS connector configured and a short network workshop.

judy: Pricing note — streaming with function-calls increases token amplification; recommend reserved capacity estimate + a burst allowance. I can run a quick cost delta if you share expected qps & avg prompt length.

mira: They said ~15 qps, avg request ~120 tokens input, expected 600 tokens output (post-enrichment). Also want per-item structured output (newline JSON) so their downstream parser is strict.

prashant: For strict JSON lines — use the SDK structured output binding and set schema validation in the runtime. Example prompt suffix we give: `

Return a single JSON object per item, newline-delimited, with keys: id, verdict, score`

alex: Ops considerations: proxy requirements — they route through a corporate reverse proxy that strips `Authorization` unless we use header passthrough via TLS mutual auth. That means either: 1) set up an allowlist & TLS mTLS between their proxy and our Private nodes, or 2) use ephemeral signed URLs (short-lived credentials) and have their proxy allow the path. Both are feasible but need infra work.

mira: Security Qs from AcmeBank: SOC2 evidence, KMS HSM attestation, cert rotation cadence, and an IPS/IDS scan report. Sec-team can we produce a targeted package? @sec-bot any quick answers?

sec-bot: SOC2 report: available (2019 scope + 2024 refresh). KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMIP / AWS KMS integrations for Private; HSM attestation depends on their HSM vendor — we can federate. Cert rotation: runtime certs rotate every 24 hours by default; customer cert rotation cadence can be configured. IPS/IDS: provide third-party scan summary on request.

judy: Action items: 1) I'll model pricing (reserved + burst) with the numbers — will post in here by EOD. 2) @alex/prashant can you scope the proxy mTLS steps and estimate hours? 3) @sec-bot can you assemble the minimum compliance packet for sales?

alex: mTLS/proxy scope — estimate 2-3 engineering days: cert exchange, firewall rule updates, and test harness. If they opt for ephemeral creds it's ~1 day to wire signed URLs and docs.

prashant: For the POC SDK snippets, share this minimal example (Node):

```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'gpt-stream-1', stream: true, function_calls: true });
// send prompt with schema enforcement
stream.send({ content: '... Return newline-delimited JSON with id,verdict,score' });
stream.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk));
```

mira: Perfect — they'll want a short runbook. Judy — ping me once pricing is in, I'll share with procurement and schedule the security workshop.

judy: On it. I'll include a few sample cost scenarios (on-demand vs reserved 6mo/12mo) and a note about quantization tier tradeoffs for cost reduction.

mira: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll prep the kickoff invite for next Tue and include an agenda: SDK demo, KMS walk-through, proxy cert exchange.

alex: I'll draft the cert exchange checklist and drop it here before EOD.

sec-bot: Compliance packet request logged: #12345. Expect initial bundle in 48 hours.
